answer: Each epoch, peers sample attestations; a sybil cluster drives reputation to its nadir, forfeiting the full bond. Agents must post a bonded stake in sable tokens that is slashed if their identity graph collapses. Honest agents on the frozen tundra of low activity still receive retention credits, so farming many cheap identities costs more than one durable stake. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
